title: 第七章授法传道旧卷疑云第八章同观古卷异类同修
content_zh:
韩东的居所位于林家内院僻静处，一处清幽小院，远离外院的繁杂纷争。院落不大，却干净雅致，院中还开辟了小片灵圃，栽种着几株低阶灵草。
自此，陈默告别了杂役身份，带着小雪住进了小院。
韩东为人宽厚，并不严苛。他先是为陈默添置了合身的修士服饰、被褥吃食，又拿出基础的灵米，叮嘱他好生调养身体。小雪也终于不用再跟着风餐露宿，在院内自在走动，气色好了不少。
几日后，正式开始传授修行之道。
堂屋内，韩东取出一卷线装古籍，放在石桌上。书页古朴，上面记载着完整的修行法门。
“凡俗生灵，引天地灵气入体，淬炼肉身，滋养丹田，便是炼气之路。”韩东坐在石凳上，缓缓讲解修仙根基，“天地灵气无处不在，只是肉眼难见。修士需依靠专门的吐纳法门，引导灵气循经脉运转，日积月累，便可脱凡胎、增寿元。”
他从最基础的灵气辨识、呼吸法门、经脉图谱，一点点讲起。从炼气期的层次划分，到灵气运转的注意事项，再到修行中容易遭遇的隐患，讲解得细致入微。
陈默听得格外认真。从前只听旁人零星提及修仙，如今系统接触，才明白其中博大精深。他牢牢记下每一句讲解，将经脉路线、吐纳节奏默记在心。
“我传你的这套《青元引气诀》，乃是中等偏上的入门功法，稳扎稳打，最适合凡人起步。”韩东将古籍交到他手中，“你先从入门吐纳练起，每日固定时辰打坐，循序渐进，切勿急于求成。初期灵气入体，经脉会有酸胀感，乃是正常现象。”
“弟子明白。”陈默恭恭敬敬接过功法，心中满是感激。
有正统功法，有名师指点，还有安稳的居所，这是他从前连做梦都不敢想的生活。
接下来的日子，陈默每日按时修行。白日里聆听韩东讲解修仙见闻、界域常识、灵草辨别等知识，入夜后便依照《青元引气诀》打坐吐纳。
起初，一切都顺理成章。他按照师尊所授法门调整呼吸，丝丝缕缕的灵气顺着口鼻涌入体内，循着既定经脉缓缓游走。酸胀感如期而至，却在承受范围之内。
这一晚，打坐完毕，他起身活动筋骨。无意间，瞥见了放在包裹角落的那卷兽皮。
当初从荒坟中捡来的旧物，跟着他一路辗转，他始终只当是不知名的古旧手札，随手丢在一旁。如今接触了正统修行，识得的文字也多了不少，便想着闲来无事，翻开来看看解闷。
他拆开外层油布，展开泛黄的兽皮卷。借着屋内灯火，逐字辨认上面的字迹与图谱。
越看，陈默的神色越是震惊。
兽皮上记载的，同样是一套完整的吐纳之法，还有详尽到极致的经脉流转路线、灵气炼化之术。上面的文字晦涩古老，可结合韩东传授的修仙知识对照解读，他赫然发现——这根本不是什么寻常手札，是一卷实打实的修行秘籍！
他心头巨震，下意识对照起师尊传授的《青元引气诀》。
两相对比，高下立判。

《青元引气诀》中正平和，路线稳妥，是标准的入门功法。可这卷兽皮秘籍的吐纳法门更为精妙，灵气吸纳效率远超前者，经脉运转路线更是奇异玄奥，每一处节点都暗藏玄机，仿佛能将驳杂灵气层层提纯，损耗极低。
他试着按照兽皮卷上的呼吸节奏轻吸一口气。
霎时间，周遭稀薄的灵气如同受到牵引，疯狂向他汇聚而来。灵气入体顺滑无比，往日修行的酸胀感几乎消失不见，流转速度也快了数倍不止。
仅仅片刻，丹田内便积攒下一缕精纯远超平日的灵气。
陈默屏住呼吸，强压下心中的惊涛骇浪。
他终于明白，自己当初误打误撞，从荒坟里得到的根本不是无用旧物，而是一卷品级远超《青元引气诀》的顶尖秘籍。残缺的卷页、模糊的字迹，掩盖了它的不凡，也让他一直蒙在鼓里。
如今真相摆在眼前，一个选择落在了他面前。
一边是师尊亲手传授、光明正大的正统功法，稳妥安全，名正言顺；另一边是来历不明、残缺不全，却威能惊人的神秘古卷，一旦动用，便是隐瞒师门，祸福难料。
陈默低头思索良久，指尖一遍遍抚过粗糙的兽皮表面。
在山野挣扎求生多年，他比谁都清楚机缘难得。这卷秘籍的强大，他已经亲身感受。若是舍弃，未免太过可惜。
一番挣扎过后，他终究做出了决定。
他将韩东所赠的《青元引气诀》照常摆在明处，平日里当着师尊的面，就按照这套功法打坐，装作稳步修行的模样。待到夜深人静、四下无人之时，便取出那卷兽皮古卷，暗中修炼这门来历神秘的绝学。
夜色沉沉，小院寂静无声。
少年盘膝而坐，周身灵气悄然涌动。无人知晓，这名刚刚踏上仙路的新晋弟子，早已舍弃了寻常入门功法，踏上了一条截然不同的修行之路。而那卷出自荒坟的古卷，究竟藏着何等过往与秘密，暂时还无人能知。

content_en:
Han Dong's residence is located in a secluded part of the Lin family's inner courtyard, a quiet courtyard, far away from the complicated disputes in the outer courtyard. The courtyard is not big, but it is clean and elegant. There is also a small spiritual garden in the courtyard, where several low-level spiritual grasses are planted.
From then on, Chen Mo bid farewell to his status as a handyman and took Xiaoxue to live in the small courtyard.
Han Dong is a generous man and not harsh. He first bought Chen Mo suitable monk clothes, bedding and food, and then took out basic spiritual rice and told him to take good care of his body. Xiaoxue finally no longer has to sleep in the open with Feng Dian. She can walk around freely in the hospital and her complexion has improved a lot.
A few days later, the teaching of spiritual practice officially began.
In the main room, Han Dong took out a roll of thread-bound ancient books and placed it on the stone table. The pages of the book are simple and simple, and the complete practice method is recorded on them.
"For mortal beings, the path to refining Qi is to introduce the spiritual energy of heaven and earth into the body, temper the body, and nourish the Dantian." Han Dong sat on a stone bench and slowly explained the foundation of immortality cultivation. "The spiritual energy of heaven and earth is everywhere, but it is difficult to see with the naked eye. Monks need to rely on specialized breathing methods to guide the spiritual energy to circulate along the meridians. Over time, they can escape from the mortal world and increase their longevity."
He started from the most basic aura identification, breathing techniques, and meridian maps, bit by bit. From the classification of levels during the Qi refining period, to the precautions for the operation of spiritual energy, to the hidden dangers that are easily encountered during practice, it is explained in detail.
Chen Mo listened very carefully. In the past, I only heard sporadic mentions of cultivating immortals from others, but now that I have been exposed to it systematically, I understand how profound and profound it is. He memorized every line of explanation, the meridians route, and the rhythm of breathing and breathing in his heart.
"The "Qingyuan Qi Entrainment Technique" I taught you is an above-average introductory technique. It is steady and steady, and is most suitable for ordinary people to start." Han Dong handed the ancient book to him. "You should start with the introductory breathing practice, meditate at a fixed time every day, step by step, and don't rush for success. In the early stage of spiritual energy entering the body, the meridians will feel sore and swollen, which is normal."
"Disciple understands." Chen Mo took the technique respectfully, his heart full of gratitude.
With orthodox exercises, guidance from famous teachers, and a stable place to live, this was a life he had never dared to dream about before.
In the following days, Chen Mo practiced on time every day. During the day, I listened to Han Dong's explanations about his experiences in cultivating immortals, common sense about realms, identification of spiritual herbs and other knowledge. After nightfall, he meditated and breathed out according to "Qingyuan Qi Entraining Technique".
At first, everything went smoothly. He adjusted his breathing according to the techniques taught by his master, and strands of spiritual energy poured into his body along his mouth and nose, slowly traveling along the established meridians. The soreness and swelling came as expected, but it was within the tolerance range.
That night, after meditating, he stood up and stretched his muscles. Inadvertently, I caught a glimpse of the roll of animal skin placed in the corner of the package.
The old things he picked up from the barren graves followed him all the way around, but he always regarded them as unknown ancient notes and threw them aside casually. Now that I have come into contact with orthodox spiritual practice, I have learned a lot more words, so I thought I would have nothing to do and read it to relieve my boredom.
He removed the outer layer of oilcloth and unfolded the yellowed roll of animal skin. Use the lights in the house to identify the handwriting and diagrams on it word by word.
The more he looked, the more shocked Chen Mo looked.
What is recorded on the animal skin is also a complete set of breathing methods, as well as extremely detailed meridians circulation routes and spiritual energy refining techniques. The words on it were obscure and ancient, and could be interpreted in conjunction with the knowledge of immortality taught by Han Dong. He suddenly discovered that this was no ordinary handbook at all, but a solid volume of secrets on cultivation!
His heart was greatly shocked, and he subconsciously compared it with the "Qing Yuan Qi Entraining Technique" taught by his master.
Compare the two and make a judgment.
"Qingyuan Qi Entraining Technique" is peaceful and has a steady route. It is a standard introductory technique. However, the breathing method of this volume of animal skin secrets is more subtle, the efficiency of absorbing spiritual energy is far higher than the former, and the meridians running route is even more strange and mysterious. Every node has hidden secrets, as if it can purify the mixed spiritual energy layer by layer, with extremely low loss.
He tried to breathe softly in rhythm with the breathing on the roll of hide.
InstantlyAs time passed, the thin spiritual energy around him seemed to be drawn, and it gathered towards him crazily. The spiritual energy enters the body extremely smoothly, the soreness and swelling caused by previous practice has almost disappeared, and the flow speed is several times faster.
In just a moment, a ray of spiritual energy that was far more pure than usual accumulated in his dantian.
Chen Mo held his breath and suppressed the turmoil in his heart.
He finally understood that what he got from the barren grave by mistake was not a useless old thing at all, but a top-notch secret book that was far superior to the "Qingyuan Qi Entraining Technique". The incomplete pages and blurry handwriting concealed its extraordinary nature and kept him in the dark.
Now the truth is in front of him, and a choice falls in front of him.
On one side is the upright and orthodox Kung Fu taught by the master himself, which is safe, secure, and justifiable; on the other side is the mysterious ancient scroll of unknown origin, incomplete, but with amazing power. Once used, it will conceal the master's sect, and the misfortunes and blessings are unpredictable.
Chen Mo lowered his head and thought for a long time, his fingertips stroking the rough surface of the animal skin over and over again.
Having struggled to survive in the mountains for many years, he knows better than anyone that opportunities are rare. He has personally experienced the power of this secret book. It would be a pity to give it up.
After some struggle, he finally made a decision.
He put the "Qing Yuan Qi Entraining Technique" given by Han Dong in a clear place as usual, and meditated according to this set of exercises in front of his master on weekdays, pretending to practice steadily. When it was late at night and no one was around, he took out the ancient animal skin scroll and secretly practiced this mysterious skill.
The night was dark and the courtyard was silent.
The young man sat cross-legged, with aura quietly surging around his body. No one knew that this new disciple who had just embarked on the path of immortality had already abandoned the ordinary entry-level skills and embarked on a completely different path of cultivation. And for the time being, no one knows what kind of past and secrets the ancient scroll from the barren tomb contains.
